name: Multi-Physics Dynamic Motor Extension
description: Family-aware motor catalogue and instrumentation with experimental induction dq, PMSM dq, BLDC phase-domain, SynRM dq, SRM phase-inductance and brushed DC excitation and reduced-order single-phase induction CPU transient models. Includes an experimental synchronous-PM AC servo cascaded position/speed/current-control CPU model; a distinct experimental rotor-flux-oriented induction-servo FOC CPU model. Includes an experimental brushed-DC servo position/speed/current cascade CPU model.
author: Subhendu Mishra

acceleration.gpu: optional Numba CUDA batch kernel for independent motor trajectories
acceleration.npu: not currently applicable to the recurrent numerical integration kernel; optional ONNX inference providers are separate
acceleration.fallback: CPU execution remains available when CUDA is absent or fails

inference.dispatch: tries installed providers in configured priority order; session initialization failure proceeds to the next candidate; CPU-only retry is attempted after a selected non-CPU provider fails at inference time
inference.fallback: CPUExecutionProvider is required; successful runtime fallback is reported in runtime_diagnostics
inference.input_policy: finite numeric tensors with statically specified sample dimensions; quantized integer inputs require an explicit model-specific quantization contract
inference.compatibility: provider availability and session provider listing do not prove model compatibility or that every graph node executes on the accelerator; hardware/device configuration and actual execution placement require runtime verification
